list: The official 55 PS5 trophies as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Guide text is written for this entry; each trophy names its sources.

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below rather than a task of its own. Plan for roughly 200 hours: the list is long, not hard — no online, difficulty or medal trophies stand in the way.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and this pops inside the first hour of the campaign. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned and cannot be missed if you play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 1. Before the chapter closes, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude, the one confirmed missable) and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter: the game has no mission replay, so chapter-start saves are your insurance for the whole run.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 2. Switching and partner play between Jason and Lucia opens up during this chapter, which unlocks the partner trophies, the Scooter Bros app (On the Spot) and the garage app (Little Boxes).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 3. Jewelry robberies (Sneakthief) open through a Chapter 3 mission, and the time-sensitive Race Against Yago event in Yago's street racing strand appears in this chapter — race it when it shows rather than leaving it for later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Chapter 4. Bank vaults become available through an optional mission near the end of this chapter, which feeds Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together in the cleanup phases.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story, gold. Complete the final mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it: with no mission replay and no New Game Plus, that save is your only way back if anything endgame-adjacent needs a second look.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the campaign mission Breakfast Run; like the other named-mission trophies it pops the moment the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story. Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece campaign mission; the trophy pops when the mission wraps up.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the campaign mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the campaign mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story. Complete VCIA Takedown, the airport campaign mission. Remember the airfield: the free-roam secret Catch Me If You Can is earned at the same airport later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story. Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late campaign mission on the road to the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold. Attain 100% Completion on the in-game tracker, which appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is done — work done earlier still counts. The checklist asks for more than the trophy list alone: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 discovered vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations among them. Work it last, in the roadmap's cleanup phases.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the 250. The 100% checklist wants 300, so if you are going for A Long Road, keep stunting past the trophy instead of stopping at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every type of activity the game offers, once each. Work through the activity icons as they unlock on the map; the counter rewards variety, not mastery, so one attempt at each type is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two shooting ranges hold 42 challenges between them, and you need gold in every one. Learn each challenge's target pattern and replay them one at a time — this is the list's main skill test, so save it for when your aim and weapons are upgraded.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Only one win per location is needed, so retry a course until the win lands, then move on to the next marker.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race do not add to the counter, so tour the race markers across Leonida and clear each one once.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take up Cal's challenge when fishing opens up and land the better catch before the challenge ends.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Any cabinet and any full game counts, so pick the shortest game on offer and play it to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Work through Andy's stranger missions to his final mission. Andy's strand carries its own trophy, so it does not count toward the 8 strands of Strangers & Freaks. Side-story finales stay available after the credits.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Work through Kenton's stranger missions to his final mission. Side-story finales stay available after the credits, so this can be finished in the cleanup phases.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Work through Billy's stranger missions to his final mission. Like Andy's and Tyrone's, Billy's strand has its own trophy instead of counting toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Not every strand counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's carry their own trophies, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand event, Race Against Yago in Chapter 3, is time-sensitive — do it when it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Work through Randy's stranger missions to his final mission. Side-story finales stay available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Work through Tyrone's stranger missions to his final mission. Tyrone's strand has its own trophy rather than counting toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the list's one confirmed missable element. Meditate at all 18 spots: they show as purple icons when you are near, and outdoor spots can count for both characters if you bring your partner. One spot is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, which only happens during Chapter 1 (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time: follow her out and accept the optional task). It disappears when Chapter 1 ends, so do it early and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side strand. Hunt the unique animal Bret Vogel asks for. Bret's hunting strand is Jason-only and works through target decks of animals; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; work set by set rather than scattering effort, because only completed sets count — and three is all the trophy asks.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo app at 100 locations. Work it into your driving routes: when a WAiNK spot is nearby, stop and snap it, instead of saving all 100 for the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the challenges listed under Progress, then Challenges. Many finish on their own as you play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80 challenges, so the trophy should land during normal play and only the road to A Long Road turns it into a grind.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star Wanted Level and escape until the heat fully clears. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Escaping a bank vault job with your partner (see Maximum Withdrawal) earns this naturally.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while your Wanted Level never drops. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so keep moving and keep the police engaged between shops. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop — give it a moment before robbing a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100 on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim triggered by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a packed group — the guards at a gang's illegal operation are ideal — and use an assault rifle; adrenaline extends Focus if the group is spread out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Back out to the runway and take off; the trophy is delayed and pops once you have flown about 1 km from the airport. Save first: the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic description means getting into a Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, then drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens these robberies: use the Snap Gun on the store's locked back door (kicking the door in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than pushing on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. A vault job gives a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. As with the vault trophies, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone entirely, not merely broken line of sight.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Tour each region as the story and the strands open it, then sweep any remaining grey patches during the cleanup phase — the WAiNK and stunt routes will clear most of it on their own.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this pops along the way if you clear operations as you find them — and their guards are the perfect crowd for Gunslinger.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one-off: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach spot, order the cocktail and take in the view until it pops. No confirmed special condition was published at launch, so treat it as a simple visit.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: take a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass frontage. Expect a Wanted Level on the way out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The riddle resolves to strength: get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner along — the partner trains alongside you, so both characters' Strength climbs together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 for this one: actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up on its own during normal play — check it in the cleanup phase before inventing a grind for it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A secret trophy whose description hints at succeeding at something on the second attempt. No confirmed unlock method was published at launch, so do not build your roadmap around it; expect the community to pin it down, and retry-style actions are the obvious experiment in the meantime.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A secret encounter trophy: the description only asks what just happened. No confirmed unlock method was published at launch. Explore odd map markers and strange free-roam encounters, and treat this as a community-discovery trophy rather than a roadmap step.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect with a person on foot. A slow pass along a busy sidewalk gives you the cleanest swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts and the cumulative total climbs. Vault work for Maximum Withdrawal feeds this on the side.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so ordinary play plus the garage purchases for Little Boxes carries you most of the way; top it off with vehicles, weapons and property spending in the cleanup.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost roughly $160,000, and garages the story hands you do not count. Buy them early: every registered vehicle for On the Spot needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy the Little Boxes garages first and register cheap cars.
